title: Networking Fundamentals
description: Sample bank covering core networking concepts (demo data).

questions.q: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing packets between networks?
questions.explain: Layer 3 handles logical addressing and routing between different networks; Layer 2 only handles delivery within a single local segment.

questions.q: Which protocol operates at the Transport layer and guarantees delivery?
questions.explain: TCP is connection-oriented and provides reliable, ordered delivery via acknowledgements and retransmission. UDP is connectionless with no such guarantee.

questions.q: What is the default subnet mask for a Class C network?
questions.explain: Class C networks use the first 24 bits for the network portion, leaving 8 bits (256 addresses) for hosts.

questions.q: Which address range is reserved for private use per RFC 1918?
questions.explain: 10.0.0.0/8 is one of three RFC 1918 private ranges, alongside 172.16.0.0/12 and 192.168.0.0/16. 169.254.0.0/16 is link-local (APIPA), not private-use.

questions.q: Which DNS record type maps a hostname to an IPv4 address?
questions.explain: An A record maps a name to an IPv4 address directly. AAAA does the same for IPv6; CNAME is an alias to another name.
